Target paths reviewed against the live catalog on 9 Aug 2026 -- several needed a "/mula" layer segment to match data/library.json (see PROJECT_STATUS.md).

ready.note: tarkasangraha.com is a JS-rendered SPA with no static/API text endpoint found -- not usable for bulk import. mula covers all 81 padartha-nirupana sutras cleanly (AnTs_1..81); the antsdi_u.htm dipika source only carries AnTs_ markers for that same 81-sutra span -- the pramana-nirupana portion (pratyaksa/anumana/upamana/sabda) that follows in that file is unmarked and lands in one final item tagged 'unsegmented'. The _r.txt 'raw' variant looked cleaner but is actually 8-bit REE-encoded, not IAST -- use antsdi_u.htm, not antsdi_r.txt.
